meta.title: 1分钟！学会7种定格动画！「附赠素材」
meta.title_en: Learn 7 Stop-Motion Animations in 1 Minute! Free Materials

scenes.context: 定格动画没有想象中复杂，拍五张照片就能完成。
sentences: 你以为定格动画很复杂，其实简单到爆炸。
You think stop-motion is complex, but it's dead simple.
stop-motion（定格动画）
只要拍五张就够啦。
Just five photos do the trick.
five photos（五张照片）
scenes.speak: You think stop-motion is complex, but it's dead simple. Just five photos do the trick.

scenes.context: 把自己一点点压扁，拍得越多越丝滑；素材重复利用很划算。
sentences: 把自己慢慢压扁，拍的越多越丝滑。
Squash yourself down gradually; more frames mean smoother motion.
smoother motion（更丝滑）
素材重复利用太香了。
Reusing footage is a huge win.
reuse footage（复用素材）
用这样的方法，任何东西都能动起来，用法真的是千变万化。
With this method, anything can move—the uses are endless.
endless uses（用法万千）
scenes.speak: Squash yourself down gradually; more frames mean smoother motion. Reusing footage is a huge win. With this method, anything can move—the uses are endless.

scenes.context: 用同样的五张照片原理，做出Vlog标题出现的动画。
sentences: 你发现了吗，文字的出场也可以这样。
See? Text can appear this way too.
text entry（文字出场）
一二三四五，Vlog标题出现啦。
One, two, three, four, five—your Vlog title pops in.
title pop-in（标题出现）
柔直展开也行，反正原理都是一样的。
A straight rollout works too—the logic is the same.
the same principle（相同原理）
scenes.speak: See? Text can appear this way too. One, two, three, four, five—your Vlog title pops in. A straight rollout works too—the logic is the same.

scenes.context: 用五张照片把背景做活，上面放置文字非常合适。
sentences: 让我们再拍五张，把它的背景做活。
Let's shoot five more and bring its background to life.
animate the background（背景动起来）
上面放置文字是非常合适的。
Placing text on top works perfectly.
place text（放置文字）
结合材质的变化，Vlog标题就用完了。
Combine it with texture changes, and your title sequence is done.
texture change（材质变化）
scenes.speak: Let's shoot five more and bring its background to life. Placing text on top works perfectly. Combine it with texture changes, and your title sequence is done.

scenes.context: 更简单的方法：拍两张照片，左右抖两下，看起来就像在说话。
sentences: 如果前面还是太复杂，下面是更简单的方法：一二，两张就够啦。
If that's too much, here's an easier way: one, two—two frames suffice.
two frames（两张照片）
只要左右抖两下，看起来就像在说话。
Just wiggle it left and right, and it looks like talking.
looks like talking（像在说话）
如果你觉得有点傻，那就换几个表情吧。
If it feels silly, just swap a few expressions.
swap expressions（换表情）
scenes.speak: If that's too much, here's an easier way: one, two—two frames suffice. Just wiggle it left and right, and it looks like talking. If it feels silly, just swap a few expressions.

scenes.context: 最后配上节奏音乐，整个定格动画段落就有了生命。
sentences: Wake up, body to the beat, body to set you free.
Wake up, body to the beat, body to set you free.
body to the beat（跟随节拍）
一段简单的Vlog定格动画就完成了。
A simple Vlog stop-motion segment is done.
simple and playful（简单又有趣）
paraphrase: body to the beat（跟随节拍
body to the beat（跟随节拍
scenes.speak: Wake up, body to the beat, body to set you free. A simple Vlog stop-motion segment is done.

practice: Five photos are enough for a simple stop-motion.
Five frames can pop in your Vlog title.
Two frames wiggled side to side look like talking.
Swap expressions to avoid the silly look.
pitfalls: Five photos are enough to start.
Shoot once and toss the footage.
Only cover the lens for transitions.
Use shapes, textures, and backgrounds too.
Keep one expression for the wiggle.
Matching the beat makes it playful.
shifts: 用 five photos（五张照片）、reuse footage（复用素材）、title pop-in（标题出现）
用 wiggle to talk（抖动说话）、expression swap（换表情）、sync to the beat（卡点）
